underlying file; the contract expressly leaves actual content and semantic
independence to root reception. Root must not fill roles with copies of a
trust statement, generic labels, historical baseline or author preparation
and call them independently received keys. No stronger source-enforced
content-independence claim is being accepted here.

## Pre-probe key remains independent and earlier

RUNTIME_PREPARATION.md:50 requires an external root observer, under the
declared ordinary-tool assumption, to receive the exact finite bootstrap key
before either author probe. The three named roles are source, bootstrap_key
and trusted_product_boundary. Each probe requires full finite pinned receipt
bytes and records originals with roles; their canonical receipt pathnames
must be distinct. The trust decision is not the bootstrap_key receipt.

The source's internal receipt checks occur after the interpreter/import
bootstrap. They cannot themselves prove that the external key was received
before launch. This temporal obligation remains a root pre-call gate,
explicitly not an attestation by the importing probe. If the already
received finite observer mechanism does not cover ctypes/_ctypes/libffi or
the selected Node surface, its affected source mechanism must first be
prepared and independently received. Late module paths/maps do not authorize
unreceived earlier dependencies. This audit neither performs that work nor
asserts that such a current key already exists.

Separately, before any operational Node/tool entry, the full independently
received finite runtime/configuration/tool key and complete fourteen-field
descriptors remain required. The new trust receipt cannot replace that
runtime key. Probe enumeration strings are not whole-file hashes, LP64/
statx/subreaper success, or current configuration/loader closure.

the collector's fixed supervisor path and Node preload path are updated.

reference mechanism accepts an explicitly received outer source rather than
hard-coding the old outer source path. Only the relevant source-reference
and prepared-request ranges of that driver were reread now; this is not a
new full algorithm review of the unchanged 51325-byte inner driver.

## Exact preserved controls and remaining limitations

The independent seven-block comparison is accompanied by complete source
reading, not used as a substitute for it. The unchanged implementation still
requires the following, conditionally on a future separately authorized run:

- Whole finite input/receipt/source bytes, alias/referent and ancestor

  stable-key exceptions remain atime and the separate ancestor identity
  projection; these are not broadened.
- Fixed ENV8 with no HOME addition; isolated/no-site/no-bytecode Python and
  actually absent configured cache; whole Python modules/maps and Node
  typed builtin/native/configuration surfaces. Source-derived finite lazy
  binding policy is distinct from an observation that a binding loaded.
- Exactly ordered help/version vectors only if separately enabled. No lookup

  waitid/waitpid/ECHILD settlement and expected-child-only reaping; successful
  inner/preload results and two calls precede final raw-stream hashing.
  This remains discrete/racy own-chain evidence, not complete SID,
  continuous process history or control over an escaped writer.
- No automatic TERM/KILL, retry, cleanup or next phase. Timeout, malformed,
  changed, unknown or live-session outcomes need separate actual root
  settlement. A source failure may leave a process unsettled.
- Complete returned product frames and normal same-session polls; normalized
  exception name/message only, not the original exception object, stack,
  cause or custom fields. The Date.now budget is checked between returned
  calls, not a hard interrupt. Unexpected handles can remain only in the
  complete frames, outside the singular active-handle field. Root must
  inspect those frames and attach actual enclosing functions transport
  originals after the event. No final outer acceptance is self-created.

These are retained scope boundaries, not new defects closed by this audit.
In particular the original OC-B limits, DQD-O1 operational evidence gate,
PCE-D1 original record and accepted exact correction are not rewritten.

differences, audit and typed invalidation, and decide whether to accept the

manuscript A/B review and terminal completion gates remain closed. The
project skill kept this work at the current source gate with historical

Only p212_trusted_product_source_audit01 was written. No reviewed program,
